review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only case. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, and the two stable task keys agree with the original PRD. The designated implementer and verifier have the supplied active trusted capability claims needed for state, shared-data, asynchronous-consumer, API, language, and testing work; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. The separately configured independent reviewer satisfies the high-risk review prerequisite without requiring execution claims. No material unresolved DEC-001 or hypothetical C input appears in this case, so the empty decision input and ready expectation are consistent. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest, evaluation-source, and whitespace-normalized PRD digest domains. The original specification's preparatory remaining/runnable fields are not evidence of a planning blocker after the supplied team and release freeze. Test excerpts are truncated, but the full owners, configuration, inventory, and file fingerprints sufficiently establish this planning expectation; this approval does not attest to complete test inspection or successful execution. I relied on the Service's mechanically bound digest evidence, did not recompute hashes or execute code, and used no candidate outputs or new human attestation.
